specName: Spec Kit presets in the Workflow Builder
request:
Issue #1032: Workflow Builder: show installed Spec Kit presets, what they replace, and search and install them. The PR body must carry `Closes #1032`.

Owner's settled decisions (do not re-ask): a clash warns and asks to confirm, it never blocks; no offline catalog cache; VS Code only (not the Copilot canvas). One "Spec Kit presets" panel (named apart from Companion's workflow presets) used in both Builder views: a side pane opened from the Header menu in Companion projects, and in place of the "Presets applied here" list in stock projects. It lists each installed preset (name, version, source, enabled, priority) and what it provides (type, name, what it replaces, strategy; Spec Kit allows types template|command|script and strategies replace|prepend|append|wrap|replace-section). It warns when a preset replaces or wraps a command Companion hooks into (read live from .specify/extensions.yml hooks whose command starts with speckit.companion.) or a stock template Companion relies on (spec, plan, tasks, checklist, constitution, agent-file templates), exempting Companion's own companion-standard preset. Search, add, update and remove are thin wrappers over `specify preset search|add|update|remove` run in a visible terminal; add, update and remove first show a modal confirm naming the files the preset replaces and any clash. Preset ids are validated before any command runs. The panel refreshes on preset.yml and .registry changes. Update tests and stories, the site's workflow-builder.mdx (a Spec Kit presets section that says how they differ from workflow presets), and one root CHANGELOG line. No version bump.
expectations: The panel in the Copilot canvas
An offline copy of the catalog
Blocking an install on a clash
